# Weibo

8 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 6 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/weibo/comment/replies - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns the replies under one Weibo comment, oldest first, each naming the comment it answers (comment.parent_id), with the province it was posted from, likes and author. Take comment_id from GET /v1/weibo/post/comments. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** Use it after post/comments, passing the comment_id of the comment whose thread you want to read.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `comment_id` (required) - The comment id, comment.id on GET /v1/weibo/post/comments. · e.g. `5361992540099003`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-20) - Replies to return, 1 to 20. Default 20.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.parent_id` | Parent comment ID for nested replies, or null for… |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |
| `comment.author.avatar_url` | URL to comment author profile picture |

+10 more (types in the full schema): `comment.author` {display_name, verified}; `comment.engagement` {likes, replies}; `comment.ext` {author_followers, author_id, author_url, ip_location}; `comment.flags` {deleted}; `computed` {language}. Never filled: `comment.author.username`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/comment/replies" \
  --data-urlencode "comment_id=5361992540099003" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/post - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Weibo post in full: the complete text, author, time, the province or country it was posted from, exact repost, comment, like and read counts, topics, every photo and the video.

**Use when** a list row shows only a shortened post, or when you need the read count that lists leave out.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - A Weibo post link, for example https://weibo.com/2803301701/Rq0Gp5523, or the numeric post id. · e.g. `https://weibo.com/2803301701/Rq0Gp5523`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+19 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares, views}; `post.ext` {author_id, hashtags, ip_location, text_truncated}; `post.flags` {deleted, pinned}. Never filled: `post.author.username`, `post.engagement.saves`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://weibo.com/2803301701/Rq0Gp5523" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/post/comments - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns the comments on a Weibo post, most liked first (hot) or newest first (latest), each with its text, time, the province it was posted from (comment.ext.ip_location), likes, reply count and author with exact follower count. Weibo stops very large threads at a few hundred comments. Pass the returned cursor for the next page; GET /v1/weibo/comment/replies reads the replies under one comment.

**Use when** you want to read audience reaction to a post. Chain comment/replies to open the replies under a single comment.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - A Weibo post link or the numeric post id. · e.g. `https://weibo.com/2803301701/Rq0Gp5523`
- `sort` (optional, enum: hot | latest) - hot (most liked first) or latest (newest first). Default hot.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-40) - Comments to return, 1 to 40. Default 40.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.parent_id` | Parent comment ID for nested replies, or null for… |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |
| `comment.author.avatar_url` | URL to comment author profile picture |

+10 more (types in the full schema): `comment.author` {display_name, verified}; `comment.engagement` {likes, replies}; `comment.ext` {author_followers, author_id, author_url, ip_location}; `comment.flags` {deleted}; `computed` {language}. Never filled: `comment.author.username`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/post/comments" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://weibo.com/2803301701/Rq0Gp5523" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Weibo account: screen name, custom address (author.username), bio, avatar, verification and its reason, exact follower, following and post counts, total likes received, the self-declared location, the IP location, gender, birthday and the date the account was created (author.joined_at).

**Use when** you want to size up an account before pulling its posts, or to get the exact follower figure that account search leaves out.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - The account's custom address or display name, for example rmrb or 人民日报. Send one of handle, id or url.
- `id` (optional, string) - The numeric account id, 5 to 11 digits, for example 2803301701. · e.g. `2803301701`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Weibo profile link, for example https://weibo.com/u/2803301701.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+24 more (types in the full schema): `author` {followers, following, joined_at, likes_count, location, posts_count, verified}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `author.ext` {business_hours, cover_url, products, activity_summary, birthday, credit_level, employer} (+5 more). Never filled: `author.private`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "id=2803301701" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/profile/posts - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns a Weibo account's posts, newest first, up to 50 a page, with exact repost, comment and like counts, the province or country each was posted from (post.ext.ip_location), topics and media. Long posts are shortened in this list (post.ext.text_truncated); GET /v1/weibo/post returns the full text and the read count. Pass the returned cursor for older posts, back through roughly the newest 2,000. media_only lists only posts with photos or video, which reach further back.

**Use when** you want to read what an account has been posting. Long posts are shortened here, so chain post when you need the full text.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈50/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/50) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - The account's custom address or display name, for example rmrb or 人民日报. Send one of handle, id or url.
- `id` (optional, string) - The numeric account id, 5 to 11 digits, for example 2803301701. · e.g. `2803301701`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Weibo profile link, for example https://weibo.com/u/2803301701.
- `media_only` (optional, boolean) - true to list only posts with photos or video. Default false.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Posts to return, 1 to 50. Default 50.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

## GET /v1/weibo/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns public Weibo posts matching a keyword or #topic#, newest first, up to 50 a page. since and until read a fixed period, back for years (measured to 2015). The latest, all, original and verified tabs continue with the returned cursor; top, hot and videos are ranked and give one page per time window; media and images give one page and take no time window. These are the posts Weibo's own search shows, so a search is not a census. Long posts are shortened (post.ext.text_truncated); GET /v1/weibo/post returns the full text.

**Use when** you want to track what people say about a brand or topic. It shows the posts Weibo's own search shows, so it is not a full census.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈50/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/50) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A keyword or a topic wrapped in #, for example 华为 or #华为#. Chinese terms match far more posts than English ones. · e.g. `华为`
- `tab` (optional, enum: latest | all | original | verified | top | hot | videos | media | images) - latest (default), all, original (no reposts), verified, top, hot, videos, media or images.
- `since` (optional, string) - Only posts from this time on: a date (2023-03-01, read as the start of that day in China time) or an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `until` (optional, string) - Only posts up to this time: a date (the whole day, China time) or an ISO 8601 date-time.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Posts to return, 1 to 50. Default 50.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+19 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares, views}; `post.ext` {author_id, hashtags, ip_location, text_truncated}; `post.flags` {deleted, pinned}. Never filled: `post.author.username`, `post.engagement.saves`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=华为" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/search/users - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns up to 50 Weibo accounts matching a name or keyword, with screen name, bio, verification and its reason, post count and gender. Weibo's search rounds follower counts, so author.followers is null here; GET /v1/weibo/profile returns the exact figure.

**Use when** you want to find an account by name, then chain profile for the exact follower count that this search leaves empty.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Weibo's account search shows one page of up to 50 accounts for a term; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A name or keyword, for example 华为. · e.g. `华为`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Accounts to return, 1 to 50. Default 50.

**Response** `AuthorList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ author }` ([full schema](schemas/AuthorList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.followers` | Follower or subscriber count as an integer. |

+6 more (types in the full schema): `author` {posts_count, verified}; `author.ext` {business_hours, products, gender, verified_reason}. Never filled: `author.following`, `author.likes_count`, `author.username`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/search/users" \
  --data-urlencode "query=华为" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/weibo/trending - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Weibo's live hot-search list (热搜): each topic's rank, title, exact heat score, category, Weibo's new or hot badge and when it joined the list. Paid placements are left out unless include_promoted is true.

**Use when** you want to see what China is talking about right now. Paid placements are left out unless you ask for them.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - The hot-search list (热搜) is one ranked board of about 50 topics; limit caps how many come back and there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `include_promoted` (optional, boolean) - true to include paid placements. Default false.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Topics to return, 1 to 50. Default 50.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {rank number, title string, heat number, category string, badge string, on_list_since string, url string, is_promoted boolean}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/weibo/trending" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
